violations.text: Food contact surfaces of deli slicer were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was dismantled for proper cleaning and sanitizing at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026

Hollandaise Sauce was observed at 131 degrees Fahrenheit in the small hot hold unit. Based on time made and temperature observed, sauce was voluntarily disposed by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026

The non-food-contact surfaces of the following were observed to have an accumulation of residue and debris: - Refrigeration gaskets -Ice machine Equipment is to be cleaned at a frequency necessary to keep clean and preclude the buildup of soil and debris. (Owner began cleaning at time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026
Walls in areas of the kitchen were observed in need of cleaning. Physical facilities are to be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

Chemical spray bottles were observed in the hand-washing sink at the time of inspection. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Spray bottles were removed for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/21/2026

Liquid eggs were observed stored above items in the back 2 Door Reach-In Cooler that are considered "ready-to-eat". Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat foods and properly stored to prevent possible cross-contamination. Liquid eggs were adjusted for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/21/2026

Utensils set-ups were observed stored directly below the paper towel dispenser at the bar hand sink. To prevent possible contamination of the clean utensils set-ups, utensils were moved for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/21/2026

The drain to the espresso machine is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other non-sewage liquids must drain into a drain. Proper liquid drainage was discussed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/31/2026

The ice machine is lacking a proper air gap (the drain line was observed draining into the mop sink below the flood rim of the mop sink. A proper air gap is to be provided at the ice machine drain line before entering the copper pipe leading to the mop sink. Proper drainage of ice machine condensate was discussed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/31/2026
